priorResearchExposure: All September dates may have been inspected in earlier work. Validation is time-separated from fitting this model, not an untouched prospective cohort.
scope: All 20 main-head partner pairs. Same base main head, per-head ticket counts, total count and alternative-head tickets. No course whitelist, fixed role score threshold or modeled-blocked hard veto.
featurePolicy: Centered secondScore and thirdScore divided by 100; scenario-specific one-hot second course and third course. No results, payout, odds, date, race ID, original ticket membership or actual finish in prediction features.
model: Conditional softmax over 20 ordered pairs, 2 score coefficients plus 4 scenarios x 2 positions x 6 courses = 50 coefficients. Nonnegative constraints on the two score coefficients.
objective: Mean negative conditional log likelihood + 0.05/2 times squared coefficient norm, projected gradient descent from zero, learning rate 0.2, 1500 iterations. No hyperparameter or cutoff search.
trainingEligibility: Stored pre-deadline six-boat scores and recorded six-course mapping, valid official saved result, no refunds/void, actual winner equals the stored main head. This condition is for fitting the conditional outcome only, never for evaluation race selection.
missingPolicy: Missing or invalid record uses baseline when comparison is possible and is reported; never fabricate missing values. Export failures are separately counted.
evaluation: All eligible validation and diagnostic races irrespective of winning head. Refund-related races excluded from primary hit and monetary cohorts with full exclusion counts. Each result joined after predictions saved.
primary: Exact trifecta hits, additional hits minus lost hits at unchanged per-race count.
secondary: Equal 100-yen-per-ticket return reported separately; do not use to choose model or offset hit loss.
interpretation: Model softmax numbers are training-model weights, not validated probabilities or confidence promises. No automatic adoption. No production writes. Hypothesis and all settings frozen before fitting/evaluation.
